releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the callsign login overlay in init(). Control path (flag off): loginOverlay stays display:none, showOverlay() shows game menu directly — original behavior preserved exactly. v1 path (flag on): login overlay shown, callsign captured, sanitized, stored in localStorage, displayed in PLAYER HUD, used as LD context key via ldClient.identify(). Evaluation uses string variation with fail-safe default 'control' so deploy is dark until flag is turned on in LaunchDarkly. Constant LD_FLAG_LOGIN added near other flag constants for consistency with existing codebase pattern.
